question: In July 2025, the 17th BRICS Summit was held in which of the following country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **17th BRICS Summit** was held in **July 2025** in **Brazil**. ***Hence, option 4 is correct.***
 
• **BRICS** is a grouping of major emerging economies consisting of:
 
 
• **Brazil**
 
• **Russia**
 
• **India**
 
• **China**
 
• **South Africa**
 
 
 
• The summit focused on issues related to:
 
 
• **Global economic cooperation**
 
• **Trade and investment**
 
• **Climate change**
 
• **Multilateral reforms**
 
• **Global South cooperation**
 
 
 
• Brazil hosted the summit as part of the rotational chairmanship system followed by BRICS nations.
 
• **Option-wise Analysis:**
 
 
• **South Africa** – Hosted the 15th BRICS Summit in 2023.
 
• **Russia** – Hosted the 16th BRICS Summit in 2024.
 
• **India** – Not the host of the 2025 summit.
 
• **Brazil** – Hosted the 17th BRICS Summit in 2025. **Correct**.
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Brazil.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BRICS** was originally formed as **BRIC** in **2006**, and **South Africa** joined the group in **2010**.
 
• The term **“BRIC”** was coined by economist **Jim O’Neill** of Goldman Sachs in **2001**.
 
• **BRICS countries** together account for a significant share of the world’s:
 
 
• **Population**
 
• **GDP**
 
• **Natural resources**
 
 
 
• The **New Development Bank (NDB)**, established by BRICS in **2014**, is headquartered in **Shanghai, China**.
 
• BRICS aims to strengthen cooperation among emerging economies and promote a more balanced global order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **BRICS Summits** are held annually under the rotating presidency of member nations.
 
• Questions related to **international organizations, global summits, multilateral groupings, and current affairs** are frequently asked in competitive examinations.
